deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 26% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.9% = 10-year Treasury 4.9% + 5%; base: sales × its 3-year median free-cash margin (5%), because current free cash flow is negative). For comparison, sales grew 22% last year; 12%/yr over 3 years — roughly in line with its recent growth.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: 49% — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $49 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity 28% (3 years ago 396%). (Tax rate estimated at 21%: effective rate not reported.)

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $664.0B, up 46% from a year ago — about 9.3× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $30.8B, up 130% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 12%/yr over 3 years and 0%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 32% vs a 5-year range of 14–32% (median 29%): near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back).
deeper.margin_position: near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back)

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: Returned $5.9B to shareholders over the last 12 months ($0M buybacks + $5.9B dividends) = 1.9% of the company's market value. Share count up 3.1% from a year ago (stock pay outpacing buybacks — dilution).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $11.06, up 1% in 90 days (up 1% in the last 30); 8 analysts raised, 7 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $8.15, up 1% in 90 days; 6 analysts raised, 7 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +31% vs a year ago · $6.31 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 31%, in step with sales (30%) (latest quarter vs a year earlier): growth comes from more business, not cost cuts.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: Beat forecasts 4 quarters running, by growing margins (0% → 15%): analysts keep underestimating it.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.sub: latest quarter +30% vs a year earlier · 12-month sales $71.8B
tiles.read: Latest quarter: sales up 30% vs a year earlier and speeding up (from 22% two quarters ago): demand is strengthening.
tiles.explain: Headline: sales over the last 12 months vs the 12 months before. Bars: each quarter's sales vs the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $32 of operating profit, about the same as a year ago.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: Free cash flow is negative: it's spending more (often on new capacity) than the business brings in.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 17× last year's profit (its lowest in 5 years); only 9× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Dec 14; analysts expect EPS of $1.89, down 16% from a year ago. It usually moves about 11% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.
